18475.d: Nardah is a small drought-stricken desert city in the south-eastern Kharidian Desert.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• The desert amulet 2/3/4 provides unlimited teleports to Nardah.
• Players can take a magic carpet directly to Nardah from several other desert settlements.
• A Fairy ring (DLQ) is located north of Nardah.
• A The Heart teleport tablet teleports players to the Heart of Gielinor, south-west of Nardah.
• The dominion medallion teleports players to the Dominion Tower, north of Nardah.
• To get there on foot, start from Shantay Pass. Exit the pass, run east, cross the River Elid, then run south-east to Nardah.
• Using the ferryman, Portmaster Kags, in the south-western corner of the Menaphos Port district.

18499.d: The nature altar is a runecrafting altar located in the Nature Rune Temple, which is used to craft nature runes from pure essence with the Runecrafting skill.

gt.heading: Access
gt.text:
As with most other rune temples, it can be accessed via the Abyss without a talisman.

Players could enter the ruins with any of the following talismans or replacements:
• A nature talisman
• An omni-talisman
• A nature tiara
• An omni-tiara
• A wicked hood imbued with any of the above
• A nature talisman staff
• An omni-talisman staff
• A full set of ethereal outfit (while such a wicked hood is in the bank or the backpack, but not in armour case)

Players can reach the ruins in any of the following ways:
• Break a nature altar teleport tablet. It teleports the player to the ruins.
• Use the Karamja gloves 3 or 4 to teleport to the gemstone cavern, take the ladder to the surface, exit Shilo Village by the shortcut to the north, and go north-east to the ruins.
• Use fairy ring code CKR and run north-east to the ruins.

18583.d: Neitiznot (pronounced "Nay-tizz-not") is a village on one of the Fremennik Isles, accessible only during and after The Fremennik Isles quest.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Players can teleport to the Fremennik Province lodestone, which is just east of Rellekka. From here they can head in to the town and take the boat to Neitiznot (north-east pier).
• Players can move their player-owned house to Rellekka, teleport to their house, then go to Neitiznot from there.
• Players who have completed Love Story can create a Rellekka tablet by using a chisel on a teleport to house magic tablet. From the POH portal they can then run north and catch the boat to Neitiznot.

18587.d: Nemi Forest is an area on Mazcab.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
Nemi Forest can be found in the North-West portion of the Mazcab overworld.

From the world window, head north, and down the hill. Then, head west at the gates of the Liberation of Mazcab.

Nemi Forest covers most of the western portion of the map.
